test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The trainer tried to guage the learners' understanding of the subject by asking several new questions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"gauge"** means to measure the size, amount, or degree of something. (मापना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company uses surveys to gauge customer satisfaction.
 
 
 
• The word **"guage"** is incorrectly spelled and should be corrected to "gauge". (गौज)
 
 
• **Example: **The trainer tried to gauge the learners' understanding
